26baebb40c.q: What is the business model of big box gyms according to Action Fitness Community founder Meg White?
26baebb40c.a: According to Meg White, big box gyms are built on the model that most paying members will not actually use their memberships. If everyone who paid their monthly fee actually showed up, the gym would not have enough equipment and would close down. The industry makes billions of dollars by design on the failure of most people.

38b1aa4d42.q: Why does Meg White argue that BMI is an inadequate health indicator?
38b1aa4d42.a: Meg White explains that BMI was created mainly based on older white men by a scientist developing an equation for insurance purposes, not for measuring actual health. She emphasizes that BMI has nothing to do with health and is one of many impossible health indicators that cause people to give up on fitness goals rather than focusing on what fitness adds to their life.

14b4c6ff3e.q: How does weight cycling affect long-term health according to Meg White?
14b4c6ff3e.a: Meg White notes that the vast majority of people who lose over 40 pounds put that weight back on, and most people doing extreme weight loss experience weight cycling, which can be much more unhealthy than simply maintaining a stable weight. She emphasizes that extreme weight loss by any means necessary, whether through surgery or restrictive dieting, often results in cycles that are worse for health than the original weight.
